Generative AI & Large Language Models: LLaMa, Qwen, Mistral, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Prompt Engineering,

Multi-Agent Systems & Orchestration: Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems, LangGraph, LangChain, Memory-Augmented Agents,

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Tech Lead – Data Science
Sutherland Global Services Private Limited
May 2022 - Present Hyderabad
,

Designed and deployed GenAI and multi-agent AI solutions for insurance and telecom industries.

Led a team of 7 Data Scientists, achieving measurable cost savings and efficiency improvements.

Delivered AI-driven QA automation, Contact Drivers, and objection-handling simulators.

Conducted technical interviews, hiring evaluations, and team upskilling sessions.

Championed the integration of advanced machine learning frameworks and cloud pipelines, bolstering deployment scalability and
facilitating rapid model iteration cycles for core client projects.
Continuous Improvement Specialist Syri Research Pvt. Ltd
November 2017 - December 2021 Vadodara
,

Partnered with business teams to deliver analytics-driven strategies and process improvements.

Built predictive models (regression, classification, clustering) to improve decision-making.

Automated data analysis pipelines, boosting efficiency and reducing manual work.
Assistant Manager Optum Global Solutions
,
June 2016 - May 2017 Hyderabad

Identified challenges and process improvement opportunities suitable for Six Sigma (DMAIC) methodology, applying a data-driven,
statistical approach to problem-solving.

Actively identified process gaps and coordinated with stakeholders for root cause analysis (RCA), implementation of corrective and
preventive actions (CAPA), and successful closure of improvement loops.

Built dashboards & automated reports to support U.S. healthcare operations.
Process Excellence Specialist Advantmed LLC
,
November 2008 - May 2016 Ahmedabad

Managed a team of 30+ members while working in operations for over five years, ensuring achievement of team targets, service
level agreements (SLAs), and overall deliverables.

Led continuous improvement & process automation initiatives across medical coding operations.
PROJECT
Multi-Agent AI System for Insurance Sales Simulation Coaching • Designed the system to serve as a training simulator to coach Licensed sales agents, enabling continuous learning from past
successes and improving objection-handling strategies through AI-generated alternative responses

Built a multi-agent AI system using LangGraph to orchestrate autonomous customer and sales agents in realistic insurance failed-
sales call scenarios.

Integrated a locally hosted Mistral 7B CS model for objection classification, LLaMA 3 8B model for context-aware response
generation, and handling multiple objections per call

Implemented long-term memory with FAISS vector store for objection-response retrieval and short-term memory to maintain full
conversational context

Extracted and labeled objection-response pairs from past transcripts to seed memory and continuously refine agent performance.
Call Summarization and Feature Extraction • Developed a GenAI-based system to summarize customer-agent call transcripts, capturing structured information such as customer
intent, objections, agent response, Medical Conditions, and compliance markers.

Integrated AWS Bedrock for managed LLM summarization and feature extraction, reducing operational overhead of model hosting.

Stored transcripts and extracted metadata in Amazon S3, enabling scalable and secure access across analytics workflows.

Automated preprocessing and post-processing with AWS Lambda, ensuring lightweight, serverless orchestration.

Delivered outputs into CX360 workflows, reducing manual QA effort and accelerating decision-making efficiency.
Natural Language to SQL Model for CX360 Portal • Developed and deployed Text-to-SQL solutions using Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int8 model to convert natural language
queries into executable SQL code.

Enabled business users to retrieve insights from databases without writing complex queries, significantly improving data
accessibility and self-service analytics on agent performance.

Collaborated with data engineering and analytics teams to evaluate SQL accuracy, optimize performance, and maintain data
governance. Incorporated safety checks and fallback mechanisms to mitigate incorrect or potentially risky query execution in
production environments.
Follow Up Call Prioritization For Lead Conversion Prediction • Developed a machine learning model to predict the likelihood of lead conversion during scheduled follow-up calls, where agents
contacted prospects at their preferred date and time after initial engagement.

Optimized agent effort, personalize outreach strategy, and improve overall conversion rates.

Achieved measurable improvements in conversion rates from 15% to 18% and lead lifecycle efficiency, while reducing agent idle
time and drop-offs in the follow-up funnel.
